mapper.select: SELECT student_id AS studentId, student_name AS studentName, experiment_id AS experimentId, experiment_name AS experimentName, airemark FROM AI_remarks WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND experiment_id = #{experimentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AI_remarks ( student_id, student_name, experiment_id, experiment_name, airemark ) VALUES ( #{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{experimentId}, #{experimentName}, #{airemark} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE student_name = #{studentName}, experiment_name = #{experimentName}, airemark = #{airemark}
